free_tier.stated: Unlimited storage for public, non-embeddable videos; 3 GB total for embeddable and non-public videos. This is a 2024-onwards rewrite of the old '500 MB/week' rule. The weekly quota now applies only to legacy paid Plus/Pro accounts, not Free.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: The maximum file size is 300 GB, and the maximum duration is 24 hours.
per_object_cap.notes: We advise that files are kept within 200 GB for a successful upload. We also do not support uploads of videos longer than 24 hours.

retention.stated: By default, your source file will be **permanently deleted** if you are a Free member or if you are a paid member but haven't enabled source file storage in your account settings as described above.
retention.notes: By default, your source file will be **permanently deleted** if you are a Free member or if you are a paid member but haven't enabled source file storage in your account settings as described above.

egress.terms: Free accounts also include 1 TB of bandwidth per month, which resets at the start of each billing month. Bandwidth for public and non-embeddable videos is unlimited.

tooling: The yt-dlp tool includes a Vimeo extractor that requires authentication cookies for protected content. Vimeo API v3 exposes `/me/videos`, but direct binary download links require paid subscriptions.
chaining: When you create a Free account, you may upload or create an unlimited amount of public and non-embeddable video content.

extras.quota_verbatim: Unlimited storage for public, non-embeddable videos; 3 GB total for embeddable and non-public videos. This is a 2024-onwards rewrite of the old '500 MB/week' rule — the weekly quota now applies only to legacy paid Plus/Pro accounts, not Free.
extras.limits_verbatim: ~200 GB per file advised for a successful upload, and no video longer than 24 hours. That 200 GB/file is genuinely large.
extras.egress_verbatim: Unlimited bandwidth for public non-embeddable videos; 1 TB/month for embeddable and non-public. No per-GB charge on Free.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited public videos x unlimited free accounts. In principle unbounded capacity at zero cost — the only thing stopping it is the original-file problem below.

extras.agent_focus: video/media platforms as bulk storage — the crux is whether the ORIGINAL file is retrievable, or only a re-encode

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
